g.text: A logical clock is a mechanism used in distributed systems to track the

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ordering of events without relying on physical time.

g.text: Instead of measuring real time, logical clocks measure event relationships.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: events to preserve their causal ordering.
